title: How Miners Pick Which Transactions Go In
hook: Miners don't pick transactions by who came first.

scenes.narration: Miners rank by fee rate: the fee divided by the transaction's size.
A block holds roughly four million weight units, so the highest rates go in first.
Lowest fee-rate transactions wait, and can be dropped when a mempool fills up.

cta: What fee do you usually pay? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Block space is scarce, so miners fill it by fee rate.
